profile.headline: Software Engineer | Software Developer
profile.summary: I am a Software Engineer with Around 3 Years of expertise on Software Developer adhering to Software Development Life Cycle like Analysis, Planning, Coding, Testing, Deploying & Maintaining of Object Oriented, Web based Enterprise Apps using Java/J2EE technology. Expertise working proficiencies in HTML5, CSS3, JavaScript, MatLab, ESRI ArcGIS Pro, Core Java and Python. Excellent knowledge of server-client and web-based applications & interactive web pages using Java/J2EE, Node & HTML5. Strong expertise in designing and developing web interfaces using HTML5, CSS, JavaScript and jQuery. Expertise in Spring functionalities such as MVC, boot, REST, Integration, Testing & JDBC. Experience in developing web applications with various open-source frameworks: Spring, Spring boot and Django. Good hands-on experience with Spring IO, Spring Boot implementing REST. Good knowledge of Agile methodologies such as Scrum. Experience in DBMS Design, SQL, MySQL and SQL Server. Experience in Database Design, Creation & Management of Schemas, writing Stored Procedures, Functions and SQL queries. Worked on JIRA with hands on experience with version control like GIT for providing common platform for all developers. Experience with different IDE’s like PyCharm, Visual Studio and IntelliJ. Excellent team player with communication skills, interpersonal skills, and problem-solving skills. Able to manage various project tasks/deadlines along with troubleshooting skills to facilitate effective resolution of problem

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.locationName: New Orleans, Louisiana, United States · Hybrid
positions.description:
- Developed Java source code for Middle Tier and/or Front-End components of a web-based application, test the developed components as units, and document the Java programs
- Participated in functional/technical group discussions with analysts and developers under minimal supervision
- Converted written requirement specifications or graphical models into sequence of detailed instructions and logical steps for coding, applying knowledge of software development
- Provided troubleshooting skill in core Java including thread dump analysis, caching, pool connections, memory leaks, thread deadlocks, and persistence configuration
- Provided written status of assigned tasks including completion percentage, identification of issues encountered, and plans for future tasks
- Worked in a dynamic environment with talented team members to deliver quality software capabilities

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Worked with the Naval Oceanographic Office (NAVOCEANO) by providing software design, development, and maintenance.
- Involved in processing, editing, and quality control of NetCDF Data inventory using Python, Java, and Matlab software
- Utilized full lifecycle software support for web applications, user interfaces, geo-processing tools, GIS map services, REST interfaces, database manipulation applications/interfaces, and workflow management tools.
- Utilized skills in Java, Python, ArcGIS, Matlab, HTML, CSS, JavaScript, Database/data design, Unix/Linux scripting and crons , Unit testing frameworks such as JEST and JUnit, Self-motivated yet able to work well within a development team, Strong oral and written communication skills

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description:
- Developed presentation layers using Bootstrap, HTML5, CSS3, and other useful libraries to build single page application
- Using java 8 in the backend and for Restful API’S we are using spring boot
- Designed, implemented and tested the Spring Domain Model for the services using Java 
- Developed user interface using JSP, HTML, CSS, JSP Tag libraries to simplify the complexities of the application
- Used jQuery plug ins for Drag-and-Drop, Widgets, Menus, User Interface and Forms 
- Involved in writing application-level code to interact with APIs, Web Services using  JSON
- Used jQuery to create animations and user interactivity using unobtrusive scripts
- Involved in web component design and development using the Angular framework, JSP, Servlets and MVC
- Designing and developing Excel Reports by developing complicated SQL Queries
- Developed SQL database scripts and wrote Stored Procedures and Triggers
- Intensively used Jira as a part of Agile scrum methodology
- Involved in the design and development phases of Agile Software Development
- Using concepts of Storage Nodes , Request Router and Auto Admin
- Using Java 8 to develop API Services in Backend by Spring boot, configuration by YML and Junit for testing purpose

positions.title: Junior Software Developer
positions.description:
•	Involved in the Design, Development, and Support phases of the Software Development Life Cycle and follow 
•	Developed presentation layers using Bootstrap, HTML5, CSS3, and other useful libraries to build single page application
•	Used jQuery to create animations and user interactivity using unobtrusive scripts
•	Developed static and dynamic web pages and also Developed the front end using JSP and HTML 
•	Responsible for the development of presentation layers using Servlets, and JSP
•	Designed the application using Front Controller, Service Controller, MVC, Factory, Data Access Object, and Service Locator
•	Working on MySQL and SQL Server for communication of data from the backend to the frontend
•	Worked on functionality, performance, and designing issues with JavaScript, jQuery, HTML, and CSS 
•	Worked on Single Page Applications (SPA) with the help of Angular and React
•	Involved in writing SQL & NoSQL Databases to Stored Procedures, Functions, Triggers, Sequences, Indexes, and Views
•	Resolved database inconsistency with better design and efficient SQL queries
•	Used Jira as the debugging tool and GitHub as the version controller
•	Actively participated in Managing team performance and progress and participated in requirements gathering, analysis, design, development and testing phases for development
